name: Andaz Tokyo Toranomon Hills
insider_take: Sleek sophistication meets traditional Japanese hospitality in Tokyo's most dynamic business district, where sky-high luxury puts you above the urban pulse.
whats_special: This architectural marvel sits atop the 52-story Toranomon Hills tower, offering unobstructed views of Tokyo Bay, Mount Fuji, and the Imperial Palace. The hotel features Japan's first rooftop bar by Andaz, plus locally-inspired design elements including traditional washi paper and contemporary Japanese art throughout its interiors.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 47-50 for panoramic city views, and time your rooftop bar visit for sunset to catch Mount Fuji silhouetted against the evening sky.
dont_miss: The nearby Atago Shrine, accessible by Tokyo's steepest stone staircase known as the "Stairway to Success," and the traditional Onarimon district just minutes away, where century-old shops contrast beautifully with the modern skyscrapers surrounding the hotel.
pros: Prime location in Toranomon Hills with excellent city connectivity
Contemporary luxury design with panoramic Tokyo views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Outstanding dining venues with innovative cuisine
cons: Modern business district location rather than traditional Tokyo atmosphere
